## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior, including unhappy paths.

## E2E coverage

- [ ] New/changed user-facing behavior has real browser + backend + storage coverage.
- [ ] Updated [feature coverage inventory](../docs/e2e-coverage.md) with test names and remaining gaps.
- [ ] Covered applicable validation, failures, reload/persistence, shared identities, collaboration and offline replay.
- [ ] For a production change with no behavioral impact, explain the reviewed coverage rationale in the inventory; do not claim the automated guard proves completeness.
- [ ] No skipped tests or weakened assertions. Production fixes include a failing reproduction before the minimal fix.

## Verification

List exact commands and results, including counts, repetitions, failures and blockers.
